name: ic-memo
title: Investment committee memo (draft)
for_each: select d.id, d.name from deals d where d.stage in ('diligence','ic','term sheet')

sections.title: The deal
sections.sql: select d.name as deal, o.name as company, o.country, d.stage, d.currency, d.round_size, d.our_cheque, d.pre_money, d.owner from deals d join orgs o on o.id = d.org_id where d.id = $1

sections.title: How we met them
sections.sql: select coalesce(p.full_name, d.source_note, 'not recorded') as source from deals d left join people p on p.id = d.source_person_id where d.id = $1

sections.title: Every touch
sections.sql: select t.happened_on as date, t.kind, p.full_name as person, t.summary, t.actor as by from touches t left join people p on p.id = t.person_id join deals d on d.id = $1 where t.deal_id = d.id or t.org_id = d.org_id or p.org_id = d.org_id order by t.happened_on desc

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.sql: select n.status, n.signed_on, n.expires_on, n.state from v_ndas n join deals d on d.org_id = n.org_id where d.id = $1

sections.title: Committee record
sections.sql: select met_on, decision, amount, currency, conditions, present from ic_decisions where deal_id = $1 order by met_on

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select c.rule, c.finding from v_compliance c join deals d on d.name = c.item where d.id = $1

name: investor-statement
title: Investor commitment statement
for_each: select c.id, o.name || ' ' || c.fund as name from commitments c join orgs o on o.id = c.investor_id where c.status in ('soft','committed')

sections.title: Commitment
sections.sql: select o.name as investor, c.fund, c.status, c.currency, c.amount from commitments c join orgs o on o.id = c.investor_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Investor certificate
sections.sql: select certificate, certificate_on as signed_on, relied_on_until, certificate_state from v_certificates where id = $1

name: portfolio-report
title: Portfolio company report
for_each: select id, name from orgs where kind = 'portfolio' and active

sections.title: Our investment
sections.sql: select d.name as deal, d.currency, d.our_cheque, d.pre_money, d.stage_since as closed_on from deals d where d.org_id = $1 and d.stage = 'closed'

sections.title: Figures received
sections.sql: select period, metric, value, unit, received_on from kpis where org_id = $1 order by period desc, metric

sections.title: Reporting
sections.sql: select last_received, next_due, reporting from v_portfolio where id = $1
